question: What is the meaning of reuse potential in relation to circularity characteristics?
description: Reuse potential refers to the ability to repurpose materials or products for the same or a different function at the end of their life cycle. In the context of circularity characteristics, reuse potential is an indicator of how well materials and products are maintained, repaired, or recycled, contributing to the overall circularity of a building or construction project. It is one of the factors considered in circularity assessments, alongside recycling potential, material circularity indicators, and circular design practices. Reuse potential is an important aspect of sustainable construction, as it helps reduce waste, conserve resources, and minimize the environmental impact of construction activities.
